# @zakkster/lite-media

> Reactive media, container-query, and preference signals built on
> @zakkster/lite-signal. Wraps window.matchMedia AND the browser's native
> @container evaluator in Signal<boolean>. Page-lifetime memoization by exact
> query string. Zero-GC steady state. One runtime dep (@zakkster/lite-signal).
> ESM-only. MIT. v1.1.0 ships Engine A (viewport & preferences) + Engine B
> (containerMedia) + createMedia() scoped instances. v1.1.2 adds a dev-only
> container-type footgun warning (dropped in production), pins the SSR
> container contract and registry-bounds invariant, and adds test/torture.mjs.
> v1.2.0 adds breakpoints({name:minWidthPx}) — one interned-token band
> computed<string> — and standaloneDisplay()/highDynamicRange(), completing
> the ten curated preference signals. v1.3.0 adds containerStyle(el,prop,value)
> — Engine B's @container style() class through the same sentinel primitive
> (0 B/flip) — and suppresses the container-type footgun warning for style()
> queries (LM-04), since a style query needs no size container. v1.4.0 makes
> Engine B multi-root: containerMedia/containerStyle resolve el.getRootNode() and
> keep one constructed @container sheet per root (main document, shadow root, or
> cross-realm iframe document), adopted into that root and built in that root's
> own realm. No API change; one --lm-v across roots; fail-closed per root; the
> per-root sheet map is a WeakMap so detached roots are not pinned. v1.4.1 adds
> a bfcache / pageshow lifecycle audit: a page restored from the back/forward
> cache re-fires no change/transitionrun, so each instance lazily attaches one
> pageshow listener that (on persisted restore only) re-reads every mql.matches
> (Engine A) and every live sentinel verdict (Engine B) and re-pushes the fresh
> boolean through the same sig.set a real event uses. Fail-closed per entry,
> page-lifetime, 0 B on an unchanged restore. No public API change. v1.5.0 is
> ecosystem wiring only: the Media.js runtime is unchanged from 1.4.1 (the sole
> edit is the version-header comment; the min+gz bundle is byte-identical);
> it ships a tested, copy-pasteable reduced-motion rAF-gate recipe for consumers
> already in the signal graph (reducedMotion() + effect({ scheduler })), its
> conformance + torture gates, and the vendor-vs-depend decision record.
> v1.5.1 is hardening only: a mechanical source-ASCII gate (test/21-ascii.test.mjs)
> that fails on any non-ASCII source codepoint except the two allowed exceptions
> (U+00D7, U+00B5). Media.js runtime unchanged from 1.5.0 (sole edit is the
> version-header comment; min+gz bundle byte-identical).

## Design in one line

JS never evaluates a query. The browser evaluates via matchMedia (Engine A)
or the native @container evaluator (Engine B); lite-media observes the
verdict and pushes a boolean into the lite-signal graph.

Consequences:
- Correctness for free: range syntax, em, dvh, container queries, cqw,
  style() — the browser handles them. No JS parser to maintain.
- Zero-GC steady state: a change/transitionrun event runs one hoisted
  handler that does one sig.set(). lite-signal's Object.is drops redundant
  events. No timers, no debounce, no schedulers.

## Numbers (Apple M4 Pro · 12 cores · Node 26.3.1 · darwin/arm64)

| Scenario                                    | Throughput      | Per-op         |
|---------------------------------------------|-----------------|----------------|
| media() cache hit                           | 213 M ops/s     | 4.7 ns         |
| Signal read (call-style s())                | 1.44 B ops/s    | 0.7 ns         |
| Preference shortcut cache hit               | 187 M ops/s     | 5.4 ns         |
| change event → sig.set → effect (1 sub)     | 46 M ops/s      | 21.8 ns        |
| Fanout to 100 subscribers                   | 849 K ops/s     | 1.18 μs / ~12 ns per sub |
| createMedia() instance creation             | 21 M ops/s      | 47.8 ns        |
| Cold materialize (mock MQL, cache miss)     | 1.6 M ops/s     | 624 ns         |
| createMedia() + 5 signals wired             | 674 K ops/s     | 1.48 μs        |

Bundle size: ~3,529 B min+gz for the full module (esbuild + gzip -9, lite-signal
external; +~264 B over 1.4.0 for the v1.4.1 bfcache resync + pageshow wiring).
The dev-only
container-type warning sits behind a `process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production"`
guard, so a production build drops it. Run `npm run bench` locally; the harness
prints a machine stamp so results are reproducible. Allocation claims are
committed as numbers by `npm run test:torture` (node --expose-gc): 0 B/flip on
media, container AND style paths, 0 B per breakpoints band change, 0 B per
stable-band read, 0 ArrayBuffer growth, 0 major GC across a 100-signal x
2000-toggle storm. Every gate ships a control that fails it.

## Public API (v1.5.1)

    import { signal, effect } from "@zakkster/lite-signal";
    import {
        media, containerMedia, containerStyle, breakpoints, createMedia,
        configure, stats,
        reducedMotion, darkScheme, hoverCapable, coarsePointer,
        forcedColors, moreContrast, reducedData, reducedTransparency,
        standaloneDisplay, highDynamicRange,
        __resetForTests, __flipForTests, __pageshowForTests,
    } from "@zakkster/lite-media";

The public runtime surface is unchanged from v1.4.0; v1.5.0 adds nothing to it
(ecosystem-wiring docs + recipe only). v1.4.1 added only the
internal __pageshowForTests(persisted) seam (mirrors __flipForTests): synthesize
a pageshow with the given persisted flag on the default instance and run the
exact gated resync body, so a bfcache restore is testable with no real browser.
On a restore, lite-media re-reads every live verdict and re-pushes it; there is
nothing new to call from application code.

### media(query: string): MediaSignal

Memoized reactive boolean for a CSS media query. Same query string => same
signal instance. Signal has (): boolean tracked read, .peek(): boolean
untracked read, .subscribe(fn): dispose. .set / .update hidden by TypeScript.

Throws Error if no matchMedia and no ssrDefault. Throws TypeError if the
configured factory returns a non-MQL-shaped object.

Failed materialization does NOT engage the lock. Caller can configure() and
retry.

### containerMedia(el: Element, query: string): MediaSignal — new in 1.1

Memoized reactive boolean for a container query, scoped to an element.
Cached per (element, query) pair via a WeakMap keyed on the element.

Under the hood: lite-media injects one @container rule per unique query
into a shared stylesheet, appends a zero-size sentinel div to the container,
and listens for transitionrun on a registered <custom-ident> CSS custom
property (--lm-v) that flips off<->on when the container matches.

Preconditions (BOTH must hold):
1. The element (or an ancestor) establishes a query container via
   container-type: size | inline-size. The library cannot set it for you — it
   would over-specify layout. In DEV builds, if neither the element nor any
   ancestor is a query container, a one-time console.warn names the element and
   the fix (warn, never mutate). Gated on process.env.NODE_ENV, so a production
   build drops it.
2. Query strings come from a bounded static set. They're inserted into a
   live stylesheet, so untrusted input is an XSS-adjacent bug in the caller.

In environments without container queries / adoptedStyleSheets /
allow-discrete transitions, the signal stays at initial:false. Graceful
degradation, not runtime error. Off-DOM (SSR / Node without a container
engine) containerMedia() returns a stable false signal and never throws — the
conservative, fail-closed verdict. Unlike media(), ssrDefault does NOT apply
to this path.

Multi-root (v1.4.0): the engine resolves el.getRootNode() and keeps ONE
constructed @container sheet per root — main document, shadow root, or
cross-realm iframe document — adopted into that root and built in that root's own
realm (root.defaultView.CSSStyleSheet), so adoption never throws across realms
and a sentinel inside a shadow root or an embedded iframe (e.g. a Twitch panel)
is styled instead of stuck-false. --lm-v is registered exactly once across all
roots; the query->id map stays global (identical data-q selector everywhere). The
per-root sheet state is held in a WeakMap so a detached shadow root or dead iframe
document is never pinned. A root that can't be styled (no realm, no constructable
sheet, no adoptedStyleSheets support, throwing construct/adopt) fails closed to a
stuck-false signal — memoized, never retried, never thrown, never a wrong-realm
sheet. A root's sheet + its rules are RETAINED on last dispose (roots-bounds
invariant, bounded by concurrent root count); dispose still removes every sentinel
and detaches every listener. The root is resolved ONCE, at the element's first
watch(), and memoized per element — relocating an element to a different root after
its signal exists is a non-goal (the engine does not re-resolve); dispose and
re-create the signal if an element moves roots.

Throws TypeError if el is null/primitive or query is not a string.

### containerStyle(el: Element, prop: string, value: string): MediaSignal — new in 1.3

Memoized reactive boolean for a container STYLE query: is `prop` computed to
`value` on the element's nearest ancestor container? Engine B's style() class.
Available on both the module-level default and scoped instances.

Constructs the canonical condition `style(<prop>: <value>)` (exactly one space
after the colon) and delegates to containerMedia — so it shares that path's
engine, memoization, disposer and _flip seam. A raw
containerMedia(el, "style(--theme: dark)") with identical spacing returns the
SAME cached signal.

Key differences from a size query:
- NO container-type required. A style() query resolves against any ancestor
  regardless of container-type, so the missing-container footgun does not apply
  — the dev-only warning is suppressed for any condition starting with `style(`
  (LM-04), covering containerStyle AND raw style() strings via containerMedia.
- NO namespace pollution. lite-media registers exactly ONE custom property
  (--lm-v). The queried property is the caller's; lite-media never registers it.
  Register it yourself with CSS.registerProperty if you want typing/inheritance.
- Same SSR contract as containerMedia: off-DOM returns a stable false, no throw.

Throws TypeError if el is null/primitive, prop is not a non-empty string, or
value is not a string.

### createMedia(options?): ScopedMedia — new in 1.1

Fundamental factory. Module-level media/configure/preferences/containerMedia
delegate to a lazily-created default instance backed by this.

Options are creation-only. Scoped instances never lock — no configure()
step, no lock error. Instance shape mirrors module surface minus configure()
and __resetForTests().

    interface CreateMediaOptions {
        matchMedia?: (q: string) => MockMediaQueryList;
        ssrDefault?: boolean;
        containerEngine?: ContainerEngine | null;
    }

    interface ScopedMedia {
        media(q: string): MediaSignal;
        containerMedia(el, q: string): MediaSignal;
        containerStyle(el, prop: string, value: string): MediaSignal; // v1.3
        breakpoints(map): BandSignal;                                  // v1.2
        reducedMotion(): MediaSignal;
        darkScheme(): MediaSignal;
        // ... 8 more preferences
        stats(): Stats;
    }

Use for:
- Per-request SSR (fresh instance per request; UA-derived ssrDefault works).
- Tests that need isolation without module-state mutation.
- Multi-mount pages with different mocks / defaults / engines.

Throws TypeError if containerEngine is malformed.

### configure(options): void

Configures the DEFAULT instance. Must be called before first successful
media()/containerMedia()/preference call.

    options.matchMedia — (q: string) => MediaQueryList-shaped.
                         Non-function throws TypeError.
                         Falls through to globalThis.matchMedia when unset.
    options.ssrDefault — boolean. Non-boolean (incl undefined) is a no-op.
                         Process-wide constant on the default instance.
    options.containerEngine — { watch(el, q, onChange): { initial, dispose } }.
                              Falls through to browser or Node inert default.
                              Malformed shape throws TypeError.

Silently ignores null/undefined/non-object. Multiple pre-lock calls compose.
Post-lock throws Error. Failed materialization does NOT lock.

### breakpoints(map): BandSignal (v1.2.0)

Compile a named breakpoint map { name: minWidthPx } into ONE reactive
string signal — the name of the active band. Available on both the
module-level default and scoped instances. Same lock semantics as media().

    const band = breakpoints({ sm: 0, md: 768, lg: 1024 });
    band();  // "sm" | "md" | "lg"  (tracked read; .peek()/.subscribe() too)

Model:
- Active band = name of the HIGHEST threshold whose (min-width: Npx) matches.
  The SMALLEST entry is the mobile-first floor, returned whenever nothing
  larger matches. Key order is irrelevant — sorted by threshold.
- One computed<string>, not N booleans. The band names are the map's own keys,
  returned by reference, so an unchanged band is ===-stable and downstream
  effects run exactly once per REAL band change, never per resize frame.
- Each boundary is a constructed (min-width: Npx) query observed via media()
  (boundary booleans are shared with media() through the same cache) — JS never
  compares widths, so the sentinel thesis holds and a band flip is 0-alloc.
- Memoized per canonical map key (any order -> same computed); counted in
  stats().bands.
- Fails loud: non-object / empty / non-finite / negative value -> TypeError at
  compile; a throwing compile caches nothing. Off-DOM follows ssrDefault
  (false -> floor band, true -> top band); neither matchMedia nor ssrDefault
  -> throws like media().
- TS: with a literal map the value narrows to the union of keys,
  BandSignal<"sm" | "md" | "lg">.

### Preference shortcuts

Each is () => MediaSignal, delegating to media() with a fixed query.
Available on both the module-level default and scoped instances. Ten total.

    reducedMotion       — (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)
    darkScheme          — (prefers-color-scheme: dark)
    hoverCapable        — (hover: hover)
    coarsePointer       — (pointer: coarse)
    forcedColors        — (forced-colors: active)
    moreContrast        — (prefers-contrast: more)
    reducedData         — (prefers-reduced-data: reduce)
    reducedTransparency — (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce)
    standaloneDisplay   — (display-mode: standalone)     [v1.2.0]
    highDynamicRange    — (dynamic-range: high)           [v1.2.0]

### stats(): Stats

    watched     — memoized media() signal count in cache
    bands       — memoized breakpoints() band computed count [v1.2.0]
    configured  — matchMedia/ssrDefault/containerEngine explicitly set?
    locked      — successful materialization has happened (always false on
                  scoped instances)

### __resetForTests(): void

@internal. Clears default-instance cache, config slots, lock, and cached
bound native matchMedia.

## Types

    interface MediaSignal {
        (): boolean;                                    // tracked read
        peek(): boolean;                                // untracked read
        subscribe(fn: (v: boolean) => void): () => void;
    }

    interface MockMediaQueryList {
        matches: boolean;
        addEventListener(
            type: "change",
            handler: (event: { matches: boolean }) => void
        ): void;
    }

    interface ContainerEngine {
        watch(
            el: Element | object,
            query: string,
            onChange: (matches: boolean) => void
        ): { initial: boolean; dispose: () => void };
    }

    interface Stats { watched: number; bands: number; configured: boolean; locked: boolean; }

## Read-only by convention

MediaSignal hides .set/.update in the .d.ts. Runtime object IS a lite-signal
Signal, so JS or TS-cast can write. Doing so permanently desyncs from the
browser until the next real change event. If you need write access, wrap in
a computed() you own.

## Memoization contract

media() and containerMedia() memoize by exact string match, lifetime of the
instance (no eviction). Query strings MUST come from a bounded static set.
containerStyle() delegates to containerMedia() with a constructed style()
condition, so it shares the same cache and the same bounded-set contract.

    // WRONG — leaks a signal + a listener per unique width, plus for
    // containerMedia a live CSS rule.
    for (let w = 300; w < 1300; w++) media(`(max-width: ${w}px)`);

For containerMedia, the query is additionally inserted into a live
stylesheet — untrusted input is XSS-adjacent.

## Allocation profile

    Op                                      | Allocations
    --------------------------------------- | -----------
    media(q) cache hit                      | 0 hot-path
    media(q) cache miss (mock)              | 1 signal + 1 handler + 1 MQL
    media(q) cache miss (native, 1st)       | + 1 bound-native fn (cached)
    media(q) cache miss (native, ≥2)        | 1 signal + 1 handler + 1 MQL
    containerMedia(el, q) cache hit         | 0 hot-path
    containerMedia(el, q) miss (1st query)  | sentinel + handler + signal + CSS rule + property (once)
    containerMedia(el, q) miss (≥2 query)   | sentinel + handler + signal
    containerStyle(el, p, v) cache hit      | 0 hot-path (delegates to containerMedia)
    containerStyle(el, p, v) miss           | same as containerMedia + 1 constructed condition string
    Signal read s()                         | 0
    change event → sig.set                  | 0
    transitionrun event → sig.set           | 0 hot-path
    Redundant event (same value)            | 0 (Object.is dedup)
    Preference shortcut call                | 0 additional
    bfcache resync — unchanged restore      | 0 retained (every sig.set dedups)
    bfcache resync — changed verdict        | 0 additional (one sig.set per move)
    createMedia(opts) call                  | 1 instance + 2 Maps + 1 WeakMap

Cost scales with verdict flips, not with browser events.

## When to use / not use

USE for:
- Twitch overlays and embedded widgets where every ms matters.
- Component libraries with breakpoint / preference / container-query gating.
- Test suites needing honest boolean semantics via mocks.
- Per-request SSR (via createMedia()).

DO NOT USE for:
- Pure feature detection (matchMedia is the wrong tool; use @supports).
- Unbounded/dynamic query strings (see Memoization contract).
- Untrusted queries — especially for containerMedia (CSS injection).

## SSR / testing

Server-side, three options:

1) Process-wide default (constant across all requests):

    configure({ ssrDefault: false });
    const s = media("(any)"); // returns false without a browser

2) Per-request scoped instance (v1.1):

    export function handle(req) {
        const m = createMedia({ ssrDefault: guessMobile(req.headers.ua) });
        const s = m.media("(max-width: 600px)");
        return render({ compact: s() });
    }

3) Mock factory (for tests):

    configure({
        matchMedia: (q) => ({
            matches: false,
            addEventListener() {},
        }),
    });

Node's --test runs each file in a subprocess by default, giving free
cross-file isolation. Within a file, __resetForTests() in beforeEach.

## Container-query test seam

Mock the container engine directly:

    const mockEngine = {
        watch(el, q, onChange) {
            registry.set(key(el, q), onChange);
            return { initial: false, dispose() { registry.delete(key(el, q)); } };
        },
    };
    configure({ containerEngine: mockEngine });
    // or: createMedia({ containerEngine: mockEngine });

## Browser & runtime support

Pure ES2020. matchMedia requires globalThis.matchMedia or a mock.
containerMedia additionally requires container queries (Chrome 105+,
Firefox 110+, Safari 16+), adoptedStyleSheets (Chrome 96+, Firefox 101+,
Safari 16.4+), and transition-behavior: allow-discrete (Chrome 117+,
Firefox 129+, Safari 17.4+) — all Baseline 2024.

Older browsers: containerMedia returns a signal stuck at initial:false.
Not a runtime error, just graceful degradation.

## Roadmap

- 1.0.0 — Engine A: media(), 8 preferences, configure, stats.
- 1.1.0 — Engine B: containerMedia. createMedia() scoped instances.
- 1.1.2 — Dev-only container-type warning; SSR container contract +
          registry-bounds invariant pinned; test/torture.mjs proof gate.
- 1.2.0 — breakpoints({ sm, md, lg }) interned-token band computed (0 B/band-
          change committed); standaloneDisplay() + highDynamicRange() complete
          the ten preference signals.
- 1.3.0 — containerStyle(el, prop, value): @container style() class through the
          same sentinel primitive (0 B/flip committed); container-type footgun
          warning skips style() queries (LM-04).
- 1.4.0 — Multi-root Engine B: shadow DOM + cross-realm iframe. One constructed
          sheet per root, adopted into that root, built in that root's realm; one
          --lm-v across roots; fail-closed per root; interleaved-dispose torture
          committed.
- 1.4.1 — bfcache / pageshow lifecycle audit: a persisted pageshow re-pins every
          Engine A mql verdict and every Engine B sentinel verdict through the
          same sig.set a real event uses. 0 B on an unchanged restore, fail-closed
          per entry; bfcache resync + live-set retention torture committed.
- 1.5.0 — Ecosystem wiring (Option A): a tested, copy-pasteable reduced-motion
          rAF-gate recipe for consumers already in the signal graph -- reducedMotion()
          + effect({ scheduler }) replaces ad-hoc checks -- with conformance +
          torture gates (0 B/flip, 0 major GC, 0 frames while parked, live-set 0)
          and the vendor-vs-depend decision record. Media.js runtime is unchanged
          from 1.4.1 (min+gz bundle byte-identical); lite-ambient-fx / lite-scratch-fx KEEP vendoring
          their own prefers-reduced-motion check (zero-dep identity); lite-media
          does not become their runtime dependency.
- 1.5.1 — Hardening only (NOT a new rung): a mechanical source-ASCII gate
          (test/21-ascii.test.mjs) with a failing control. No runtime change;
          min+gz bundle byte-identical to 1.5.0. [current]

Watchlist: CSSWG #6205 (native Element.matchContainer). If it ships, engine
B collapses to a feature-detected bridge with unchanged signal-graph surface.

## File layout

    Media.js       — single-file ESM implementation (~1032 lines)
    Media.d.ts     — TypeScript declarations
    test/01…21-*.test.mjs      — 209 tests across 21 files
    test/torture.mjs — the proof gate (node --expose-gc): committed 0-B numbers,
                      incl. the v1.5.0 reduced-motion rAF-gate tiers
    bench/bench.mjs — machine-stamped benchmark harness
    demo/index.html — oscilloscope demo (preferences, breakpoints, containerStyle,
                      shadow-root containerMedia, bfcache resync, reduced-motion
                      rAF gate)
    README.md, llms.txt, LICENSE.txt, CHANGELOG.md

## Install

    npm install @zakkster/lite-media @zakkster/lite-signal
